description:
A user's verdict on a workout from these tools: a mistake (wrong
    equipment, a weight, a dose that cannot fit), or a workout they found bad
    or good. Stores the user's words for Goblin Gains, nothing else about the
    user.

note.description: What the user said about the workout, in their words. Example: "Farmers carry needs two dumbbells; I said I have one."
note.title: Note

verdict.description: One of mistake, bad, good: "mistake" (something in it is wrong), "bad" (it works but is a poor workout), "good". Example: "mistake".
verdict.title: Verdict

workout.description: The workout's save link from suggest_workouts, vary_workout or generate_workouts, or its id; omitted for the tools as a whole. Example: "https://app.goblingains.com/w/<id>".
workout.title: Workout

name: report_workout
title: Report a workout
